title: Scenario 4: Visa 10.4 — OTA Virtual Card (Booking.com VCC)
description: Guest booked via Booking.com and paid the OTA; the hotel charged the OTA's single-use virtual card. The dispute names the OTA as cardholder while the folio names the guest — a third-party payer case, not a name mismatch error.

guide.purpose: OTA virtual-card booking where cardholder and guest legitimately differ.
steps: Upload the Visa notice and folio.
Verify cardholder Booking.com B.V., guest Priya Nair, channel OTA, source Booking.com, and payer relationship.
Upload the registration, ID, keycard, booking confirmation, and service-log evidence.
Draft and review the third-party-payer explanation before approval.
expected: THIRD_PARTY_PAYER appears as informational, not NAME_MISMATCH.
Folio identity is evaluated in OTA context; do not expect guest and cardholder names to match.
The rebuttal should reference the OTA confirmation and virtual-card booking context.
